tagline.en_US: An XMPP server for messaging and federation using the official ProcessOne image. The profile exposes port 5222 for XMPP and port 5280 for the web admin; the default XMPP domain is localhost and should be changed before external use.

description.en_US: ejabberd is an open-source realtime communication platform built using Erlang/OTP. It functions as an XMPP server, an MQTT broker, and a SIP service. The platform is designed for scalable and extensible real-time messaging and data exchange.
